description: Co-founder dispatches an ad-hoc investigation (why did Retargeting CPA double on Friday?); meta-ads-agent claims, reads API creds + thresholds from the vault, pulls entity-level insights via the Graph API (web_fetch, declared on the workflow), ships the reversible fix (re-tightens an audience expansion) with audit-log capture, files findings on the ticket, and completes with result + digest.

inputs.question: Why did CPA double on Friday?

dispatch.title: Investigate CPA doubling on Retargeting — Warm 30d

args.title: Investigate CPA doubling on Retargeting — Warm 30d

args.note: ad-set daily breakdown Thu-Sun + delivery estimate; Advantage audience expansion toggled on Friday
reversible fix: disable Advantage audience expansion (tighten audience — autonomous-allowed); before/after to AuditLog/2026-06-12.md

args.comment: Root cause: Advantage audience expansion auto-enabled Friday widened Warm 30d to cold traffic — CPA $44 -> $91. Expansion disabled (reversible, audit-logged); CPA should normalize within 48h.

args.result: Investigation complete: Retargeting — Warm 30d CPA doubled because Advantage audience expansion was enabled Friday, diluting the warm pool with cold traffic (CPA $44 -> $91, frequency dropped 3.1 -> 1.4). Reversible fix shipped: expansion disabled, before/after audit-logged. Watch item: confirm CPA back under $50 by Sunday.
args.digest: Ran meta.investigate on Warm 30d retargeting: cause was Advantage expansion, now disabled and audit-logged. Next wake: 09:00 sweep — verify CPA normalizing on this ad set.
